name: Nie Kari no Ato
source:
A young man and a striking beauty arrive to the island. The man is invited as a tutor, but the true aim is to participate in the revenge ritual where the girl is the victim.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名年輕男子與一位美得令人驚豔的女子來到小島。男子受邀擔任家庭教師，但真正目的是參加復仇儀式，而女孩正是儀式的受害者。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
